business_problem: FloBiz needed myBillBook to work reliably across mobile, web, desktop, online, and offline environments while handling complex SMB accounting data, background synchronization, and multi-user conflict resolution that its initial PostgreSQL MVP could not scale to support.
solution_summary: FloBiz rebuilt myBillBook on MongoDB's managed data platform so India's small businesses could use invoicing, accounting, and workflow tools across devices without losing data when connectivity drops. MongoDB Atlas on Google Cloud became the backend system of record for billing, inventory, and business documents, while Realm, Atlas Device Sync, and Atlas App Services gave FloBiz an offline-first mobile and desktop architecture that keeps accounts synchronized even when multiple users work on the same business from different devices. The flexible document model let the team absorb highly variable invoice, product, and workflow data without repeated schema rewrites, and MongoDB Atlas Charts provides built-in visibility into deployment and monitoring information. By consolidating storage, sync, and application services into one stack, FloBiz avoided stitching together Firebase, Redis, SQLite, and custom sync software while gaining a single source of truth for a multi-platform product.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas
solution_components.role: Stores myBillBook's billing, inventory, and workflow data as the backend source of truth on Google Cloud.

solution_components.name: Atlas App Services
solution_components.role: Provides the application services layer that connects client apps to Atlas and supports the broader cross-platform backend.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Device Sync
solution_components.role: Keeps data synchronized between client devices and Atlas when users move between online and offline states.

solution_components.name: Realm
solution_components.role: Acts as the local mobile database that powers myBillBook's offline-first user experience.

solution_components.name: MongoDB Atlas Charts
solution_components.role: Visualizes deployment and monitoring data for the FloBiz team directly from the MongoDB platform.

data_flow: Invoice, inventory, payments, and workflow data is captured in myBillBook's mobile, desktop, and web apps, stored locally in Realm when devices are offline, synchronized through Atlas Device Sync and App Services, persisted in MongoDB Atlas on Google Cloud, and then surfaced through Charts for operational visibility.
business_outcome: FloBiz scaled myBillBook to more than six million downloads and a million monthly users, cut update transaction times by 90%, reduced CPU drain by 50%, and improved developer productivity by replacing a patchwork architecture with one synchronized data platform.
